source.quote: Yulong's own page for the DA10, read 2026-11-25 over plain HTTP, the host having no usable HTTPS. The page title marks it « Discontinued ». « USB Audio / PCM:   upto   32Bit/768kHz / DSD:   DoP64,   DoP128, Native DSD64/128/256/512 » and « S/PDIF (Coaxial, AES, Optical) / PCM: upto 24Bit/384kHz / DSD: DoP64 and DoP128 ». A features bullet: « All inputs interface support DoP64 and DoP128, USB input interface supports Native DSD64/128/256/512 additionally. » On the converter, SPELLED TWO WAYS ON ONE PAGE: the prose says « It is designed around AKM's Premium 32-bit AK4497EQ DAC chipset » and the features bullet says « Design around AK497EQ DAC chipset with industry-leading 32Bit/768kHz and DSD512. » Filters: « Choices of 3 digi talfilters and three SSM (Sound Signature Modes) to fine tune your system for different music genres and personal preference . » - spacing as printed.

facts.chip: « AKM's Premium 32-bit AK4497EQ DAC chipset » in the prose and « AK497EQ » in the features bullet - one part, two spellings on one page, and AK497EQ does not exist. Neither is corrected: a part number is what a consumer's engine dispatches on, and quietly repairing a maker's typo turns a record into an interpretation.

device_settings.why: « Choices of 3 digi talfilters and three SSM (Sound Signature Modes) » - three filters and three sound modes, both counted, neither named. The SSMs are deliberate shaping and are not recorded as filters.

_conditions_NON_CONCLUANTES_chez_Yulong: No terms page found on yulongaudio.com, so no prohibition could be checked - NOT the same as finding none. Measured 2026-11-25: the site has exactly five sections, About Us, Products, News, Support and Contact Us, identical on the English and Chinese trees, and none is legal; no terms, legal, copyright-policy or privacy page is linked from any nav or footer. robots.txt returns 404 with the body « File not found », so no Content-Signal and no Claude group exist because the file does not. Footer on every page: « Copyright (c) 2003-2017 All Rights Reserved Shenzhen Yu Long Yun Electronics Co., Ltd. » - note the end date, nine years stale.
_HTTPS_est_inutilisable_sur_cet_hote: yulongaudio.com, www.yulongaudio.com and daartaudio.com all fail TLS with « no alternative certificate subject name matches target host name », so the site is reachable only over plain HTTP and every URL in this record is http://. yulong-audio.com, en.yulongaudio.com, daart.audio, yulongaudio.cn and da-art.com do not resolve. Second maker today unreachable to any tool that upgrades to HTTPS, after MUSICIAN Audio Technology.
_la_moitie_du_catalogue_nexiste_quen_ima: Yulong's site splits cleanly: the older models carry real specification TEXT in the page body, and every newer model's product detail is nothing but JPEGs - 42 characters of whitespace as the only text. And the Support page offers DRIVERS ONLY, no manuals at all, so for the image-only models there is no text fallback anywhere on the maker's site. The Chinese tree was checked as a fallback and is the same images. Nine models are therefore absent from the base for want of text: Aquila III, Aurora, DA1, DA11, D39, DA2, ASURA, A39 and DP1. No number was read off any image.
_une_puce_ecrite_AK497EQ_a_cote_de_AK449: One page, one part, two spellings - « AK4497EQ » in the prose and « AK497EQ » in the bullet, a digit short. Quoted as printed and not repaired, for the same reason the MHDT Orchid 69SE's « TDA541A » was left alone. Third record this week where a maker drops a digit from its own converter's name, after that one and EC Play's CS43918 against CS43198.
